description: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility_criteria: Poor and vulnerable families based on SECC 2011.

description: Provides quality generic medicines at affordable prices.
eligibility_criteria: All citizens of India.

description: Supports strengthening of health systems and improving healthcare delivery across rural and urban India.
eligibility_criteria: All citizens, especially pregnant women and children.
application_steps: Avail free maternal and child health services.

description: Provides income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility_criteria: All landholding farmers' families in the country.
Must own cultivable land.

description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers growing notified crops in a notified area.

description: Aims to enhance physical access of water on farm and expand cultivable area under assured irrigation.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers with cultivable land.

description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity.

description: Financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry.
eligibility_criteria: Startup recognized by DPIIT.
Incorporated not more than 2 years ago.
Must have a scalable business idea.

description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibility_criteria: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneur.
Above 18 years of age.
Greenfield enterprise only (first-time venture).
application_steps: Apply for loan online or directly at a bank branch.

description: End-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople, providing training, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit.
eligibility_criteria: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools.
Minimum age of 18 years.
Engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades.

description: Addresses the declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and related issues of women empowerment.
eligibility_criteria: Girl child born in a family.

description: A small savings scheme exclusively for women and girls with a fixed interest rate.
eligibility_criteria: Any woman or girl child in India.

description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to women from below poverty line (BPL) households.
eligibility_criteria: Adult woman belonging to a BPL household.
No existing LPG connection in the household.

description: Housing for All scheme providing central assistance to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and other implementing agencies.
eligibility_criteria: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Annual income limit applies (EWS/LIG/MIG).
application_steps: Apply on PMAY-U website or CSC.
Receive Credit Linked Subsidy on home loan.

description: Aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless families and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
eligibility_criteria: Houseless families or those living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses.
Identified using SECC 2011 parameters.
application_steps: Gram Sabha verifies the eligible beneficiaries list.
Submit bank details to local Panchayat.
Funds transferred directly to bank account in installments.

description: Provides financial assistance to SC/ST/OBC students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage.
eligibility_criteria: Must belong to SC/ST/OBC category.
Family income limit applies.

description: Awards scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue study.
eligibility_criteria: Students studying in Class VIII in Government/Aided/Local Body schools.
Parental income below ₹3.5 Lakhs.
application_steps: Clear the State level selection test.

description: A government-sponsored savings instrument for individuals aged 60 years or above.
eligibility_criteria: Must be 60 years of age or older.
application_steps: Visit Post Office or authorized bank.

description: A guaranteed pension scheme administered by PFRDA providing a minimum guaranteed pension ranging from ₹1000 to ₹5000 on attaining 60 years.
eligibility_criteria: All Indian citizens between 18-40 years of age.
Must have a bank account.
application_steps: Visit your bank branch or apply via NetBanking.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Provides financial assistance to destitute senior citizens under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP).
eligibility_criteria: Must be 60 years of age or higher.
Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
application_steps: Collect application form from local Panchayat/Municipal office.
Pension is transferred to bank/post office account.
